title: The Second Vanishing Theorem in Ramified Mixed Characteristic
summary: Local Cohomology, since its introduction, has served as an important invariant for commutative rings and their modules. They furthermore provide the local model for relative cohomology groups for schemes. As with all cohomology theories, vanishing theorems are widely sought after, and for local cohomology a classical theorem of Grothendieck states that all local cohomology vanishes past the dimension of the ring.
